title: Improving Counterfactual Plausibility Through Generative Manifold Constraints
summary: A bachelor's thesis project that generates plausible counterfactual explanations for tabular classifiers (South German Credit and MIMIC-IV) by searching a heterogeneous VAE's latent space under proximity, sparsity, and manifold-plausibility constraints. An optional augmentation routine in tabular_vae.py imports SDV's TVAESynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to fit on the real data and sample additional synthetic rows before VAE training.
